display.functional_prior: pollinator-benefit and reproductive-enemy-cost evidence both available

display.status: size component ready for phylogenetic expansion; head-number component still needs direct table

stickiness.trait_coverage: Japan38 NMNS sticky/nonsticky state resolved for 12 concepts
stickiness.functional_prior: direct Cirsium neutralization result weakens generic defence hypothesis
stickiness.status: ready as macroevolutionary negative-control module once Japan38 tree exists

colour.functional_prior: pollinator preference and abiotic-pigment hypotheses remain context dependent
colour.status: ecological/history module valuable but fixed-white breadth remains the immediate transition-history blocker

cross_module.interpretation: Current direct measurements do not support collapsing all capitulum variation onto one obligatory display-defence-orientation axis. This retains modularity and common-lability as competing hypotheses rather than choosing between them.

tree_dependency: Japan38 compatibility rebuild PR #88 is executing 39 biological samples / 40 SRRs in the frozen conservative Comp1061 space. Multi-trait ASR must wait for that tree rather than inventing the unavailable Moreyra final-350 tree.
claim_boundary: Readiness and diagnostic synthesis only; no adaptive-radiation or functional causation claim.
